scope: The 29 explicitly listed destination guides only
decision: These pages may be indexed when the dataset is production because they publish a restricted selected-model-cell climatology, pass the destination-specific evidence checks below and agree with an independent signed season label.

evidence.publicClaimRestriction: one selected representative model-grid cell; not a whole-region or route-specific average

reviewNotes.standardDistanceRule: Twenty-eight approved destinations are within 13.04 km of the configured destination point and below the audit's 20 km review threshold.
reviewNotes.denaliException: Denali is 74.32 km from the massif coordinate because the selected cell intersects the official NPS Savage Canyon Trail geometry; the audit records independentNamedRouteEvidence=true and no spatial error.
reviewNotes.torresDelPaineOverride: The 13.04 km eastern trail-sector override avoids the western permanent ice-field indicator cell and remains below the review threshold.
reviewNotes.independentDiagnosticLimit: NASA POWER is an independent coarse reanalysis diagnostic, not station truth. Absence of a flag is one conservative check and is never treated as proof by itself.
reviewNotes.confidenceBoundary: All current scored months retain the provisional single-point cap of 64/low. Indexability approval is based on restricted claim scope plus converging evidence, not on changing that value.
